timeout_preservation: Every scientific child retains its original receipt timeout (45 or 60 seconds). The outer 75 seconds includes orchestration and cannot extend a child timeout.
comparison: Complete observed result_raw, stdout and stderr equal frozen originals. Only a unique JSON candidate pathname token is relocated to its actual temporary hash-pinned candidate.py. Original bytes are never rewritten. No other field or stream normalization.
raw_api_order: Full INNER execute_runner return saved first, before execute_and_write_cache post-identity; full OUTER tuple saved first after return. Opaque pickle and complete readable tagged JSON retained; no unpickle.
cache_input_order: All payloads, original EVIDENCE_MAP, literal PUBLICATION_EDITS, helper resources, RUNTIME, notes and declarations finalized before canonical calls. Reconstruction before/after vocabulary --fix plus checked report-only. Late PREPARATION/VALIDATION maps and SOURCE_IDENTITIES are not declared inputs.
graph_rule: All prior complete node records and edges remain byte-equivalent as parsed JSON; new exact direct dependencies only.
audit_boundary: Focused exact-base compatibility only. Global combined validation and strict audit lint are separate landing gates. No audit application, retained promotion, Git/index/remote/PR or prompt mutation.
failure_rule: Stop and preserve partial evidence. No automatic science retry and no re-execution of old milestones or independent reviewer controls.
ownership: Root alone executes the program and later handles exact-path Git/publication. This preparer owns S script and its S support directory only.
pairing: Same selected model family and reasoning effort, separate author/reviewer contexts with candidate formulas exposed; not blinded or diverse-family. Root supplied routes and is a coauthor. Mechanical packaging adds no independent scientific review.
